"""In-memory persistence layer. Only app.services may import this module."""

_USERS = {
    1: {"id": 1, "name": "Ada", "email": "ada@example.com"},
    2: {"id": 2, "name": "Linus", "email": "linus@example.com"},
}


def get_by_id(user_id: int) -> dict | None:
    user = _USERS.get(user_id)
    return dict(user) if user else None


def find_by_email(email: str) -> dict | None:
    for user in _USERS.values():
        if user["email"] == email:
            return dict(user)
    return None


def get_all_users() -> list[dict]:
    return [dict(u) for u in sorted(_USERS.values(), key=lambda x: x["id"])]
"""User service: business logic between the api and db layers."""

from app.db import store


def get_user(user_id: int) -> dict | None:
    return store.get_by_id(user_id)


def list_users(page: int, page_size: int) -> tuple[list[dict], int]:
    all_users = store.get_all_users()
    start = (page - 1) * page_size
    end = start + page_size
    return all_users[start:end], len(all_users)
"""Request handlers. Handlers receive untrusted params and call app.services only."""

from app.services import users


def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
    raw = params.get("id")
    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
    if user is None:
        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
    return 200, user


def handle_list_users(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
    page_str = params.get("page", "1")
    size_str = params.get("page_size", "10")

    if not (
        isinstance(page_str, str) and page_str.isdigit() and
        isinstance(size_str, str) and size_str.isdigit()
    ):
        return 400, {"error": "invalid pagination"}

    page = int(page_str)
    size = int(size_str)

    if page < 1 or not (1 <= size <= 100):
        return 400, {"error": "invalid pagination"}

    page_users, total = users.list_users(page, size)
    return 200, {
        "users": page_users,
        "page": page,
        "page_size": size,
        "total": total
    }
